competitiveTarget: The homepage is the brand's front door. Beat Coldwell Banker / Windermere / eXp Central Oregon home pages by leading with live local market data + open houses + real broker presence instead of a stock hero + IDX search box (EXECUTION_PLAN §8).
note: The homepage was already rebuilt onto the Wave 2 site-v2 blocks (no legacy components left), so this contract is NOT baselined — it passes immediately and exists to LOCK the block set against regression. SiteHeader/SiteFooter are intentionally omitted from requiredComponents because they render from app/layout.tsx, not app/page.tsx (the gate checks the route file's imports).

requiredComponents.name: Hero
requiredComponents.section: hero — 'Find Your Home in Central Oregon' + search-everything bar + canonical Old Mill drone photo

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: Central Oregon / Bend market snapshot — live SFR stat cards from getMarketPulse + getMarketStats

requiredComponents.name: FeaturedListings
requiredComponents.section: 'Featured Central Oregon homes' — premium active inventory slider (getListings, price-desc). Real homes high on the page, not just search entry points.

requiredComponents.name: PriceRangeTiles
requiredComponents.section: 'Browse by price range' — budget-bracket tiles linking to filtered search

requiredComponents.name: OpenHousesGrid
requiredComponents.section: 'Open houses this weekend' — upcoming open houses across the service area (getUpcomingOpenHouses, spec homes filtered out)

requiredComponents.name: CityGrid
requiredComponents.section: 'Explore Central Oregon' — city photo cards (Bend, Redmond, Sisters, Sunriver, La Pine, …) via getGeoTileImages

requiredComponents.name: ResortCommunities
requiredComponents.section: 'Resort + master-planned communities' — 8 marquee resort/golf community photo cards (Tetherow, Broken Top, Pronghorn, …) with live median + active count from getCommunityBySlug, linking to /communities/[slug]

requiredComponents.name: TeamSection
requiredComponents.section: 'Meet the team' — the three brokers (Matt, Paul, Rebecca) with transparent headshots

requiredComponents.name: ActivityFeed
requiredComponents.section: 'What's happening right now' — live new / price-drop / pending / sold activity

requiredComponents.name: CtaDuo
requiredComponents.section: buyer + seller dual CTA band — 'Find your home' / 'List your home'
